cohort: The participants were 65 neonates born at >=34 weeks gestational age who had their temperature assessed in the delivery room.
finding: Temperature assessed by an infrared thermometer at the forehead site showed good reliability with a digital thermometer at the axillary site for thermal management in neonates in the delivery room.
mod_finding: The intraclass correlation coefficient between IRT and DT was good during skin-to-skin contact for vaginal-born neonates (ICC = 0.881) and for neonates cared under radiant warmer (ICC = 0.846) for cesarean-born neonates.
